name: 植物水感清爽保湿乳液款
description: 薄荷植物水彩视觉，补水-锁水-储水机制叙事的保湿乳液套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: ice-mint watercolor-botanical panels #EAF5F3 and warm paper white #F7F5F1 for info screens, warm mist grey studio backdrop #ECEAE7 for packshots, deep teal banner tone #17323B reserved for mood and closing strips
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, clean water-splash accents on benefit shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC, matte warm-grey board #ECEAE7, warm paper board #F7F5F1
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal #245B57 with wide letter-spaced caption lines, all copy wrapped in 「」; no serif or handwritten mixing; aqua #4E9A93 reserved for numbered circles, connectors and small badges
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles only, in deep teal #245B57 or aqua #4E9A93
styleLock.presentationRules: product always upright at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale; water splash allowed only at the product base; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no logo or brand marks anywhere
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice-mint white #EAF5F3, warm mist grey #ECEAE7, deep teal text #245B57 and one aqua accent #4E9A93, with a deep teal banner tone #17323B reserved for mood and closing strips; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and clean water-splash accents; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal with wide letter-spaced caption lines; consistent thin-line icon style in deep teal; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal watercolor-botanical and infographic elements; stable upright product presentation at a slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 11 张 800×1200 高清切片实测（整页 12041px 详情长图，相邻重叠 60px 已去重）。已剥离源品牌字/logo、模特面部、原文案、授权书扫描件、含竞品的货架照片与二维码内容；资质证明类内容不可写实，信任镜改以瓶身工艺细节与真实棚拍呈现，未虚构任何功效、数据或认证。三条装饰性氛围横幅（怀表/沙漏/绿植）并入背景体系不入镜。实测有效屏 13 处，去重合并后映射 10 镜，漏斗补全 2 镜（晨间场景、质地微距），共 12 镜。
